requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL consume the ontology OM through Class, Object, Field, FieldValue, ComputedProp, RelationDef, RelationLink, and Operation vocabulary without legacy compatibility aliases.

case.given: knowledge-base code, tests, and direct Cozo queries depend on the ontology package
case.when: knowledge-base defines classes, creates objects, persists field values, creates relation links, and exposes operations
case.then: system SHALL use the renamed ontology APIs, DTOs, tables, and columns

case.given: project skills, prompts, validators, examples, and docs explain ontology modeling
case.when: an agent or developer reads or executes those assets
case.then: they SHALL be guided toward Class/Object/Field/ComputedProp/Relation/Operation vocabulary and SHALL NOT be taught old OM terms as active names
